purpose: Phase 04 SIT scenario manifest for the protected dual-channel pipeline. Each scenario mirrors a deterministic mock scenario in integration/test_phase03_gate.py and must be replayed against the DEV/SIT test accounts with real credentials from the Secret Manager. No credential values appear here.

code_under_test.note: Final RC SHA/tag is stamped by the protected pipeline at tag time.

preconditions: mode set to sandbox via approved feature flag; mock remains the default
test accounts with hard budget limits and named cleanup owners
official-doc verification record complete per docs/runbooks/channel-token-rotation.md
egress proxy + FQDN allowlist active; no public inbound/webhooks

scenarios.name: closed_loop_golden_path
scenarios.expect: draft -> dry-run -> approval -> publish CREATED -> reconcile -> raw metrics -> normalized -> report -> DRAFT strategy; exactly one external object

scenarios.name: dry_run_unknown_account
scenarios.expect: invalid, zero external calls

scenarios.expect: invalid, zero external calls

scenarios.expect: invalid, zero external calls

scenarios.expect: invalid, zero external calls

scenarios.expect: FAILED before connector; zero external writes

scenarios.name: input_hash_mismatch
scenarios.expect: token rejected; zero external writes

scenarios.name: token_expiry_during_publish
scenarios.expect: non-retryable FAILED; zero external objects

scenarios.name: http_429_with_retry_after
scenarios.expect: queued retry honoring Retry-After; exactly one object after recovery

scenarios.name: timeout_after_external_create
scenarios.expect: UNKNOWN -> reconcile-before-retry -> RECONCILED; no second object

scenarios.name: duplicate_delivery_100x
scenarios.expect: one external object; 100% dedupe via operation ledger

scenarios.name: worker_restart_replay
scenarios.expect: ledger dedupe; no re-consume of approval; one object

scenarios.name: partial_hierarchy_or_mutate_success
scenarios.expect: COMPENSATION_PENDING + pending-approval task; no further writes

scenarios.name: undecidable_reconcile
scenarios.expect: WAITING_RECONCILIATION -> DLQ/manual queue; never recreate

scenarios.name: backend_manual_modification
scenarios.expect: drift reported by get_status/reconcile; never auto-overwritten

scenarios.name: metrics_duplicate_pull
scenarios.expect: raw dedupe by source_response_hash; zero duplicate raw rows

scenarios.name: metrics_missing_values
scenarios.expect: not_available preserved; never coerced to 0

scenarios.name: report_traceability
scenarios.expect: every number carries source_raw_metric_ids + formula_version fv1

scenarios.name: strategy_draft_only
scenarios.expect: status DRAFT, executed false, evidence-bound; zero write-tool calls

evidence_required: external object IDs and cleanup ticket per created object
approval ids, input hashes, idempotency keys, audit trail export
raw metric source_response_hash list and normalized formula_version
P3-CP01..P3-CP06 sign-off by named QA / API Owner / Marketing / Security
